channel.title: Office Software Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: ShopRaise Workplace Giving Review (2026): Pricing Notes
item.description: ShopRaise Workplace Giving: ShopRaise sells a single package called All-In at $2 per employee per month. We could not read ShopRaise's own pricing page.

item.title: Make Review (Tested 2026): Visual Automation, Free to $15
item.description: Make, Free: $0, 1,000 credits a month, 15-minute minimum interval. Billing is by credits and the price moves with the slider.

item.title: Zapier Review (2026): App Automation From $19.99 a Month
item.description: Zapier: Free costs $0 and includes unlimited Zaps, Tables and Forms, two-step Zaps and 100 tasks a month. Free allows only two-step Zaps.

item.title: PayRewards Review (2026): 1.75% Fee, Earn Points on Bills
item.description: PayRewards: Delivery fees are $16 per wire transfer and $5 per paper check. Every payment carries a percentage fee, 1.75% to 3.25% plus 2.9% on cards.

item.title: Gymcatch Review (2026): Studio Booking From £10 a Month
item.description: Gymcatch is booking and customer management software for fitness and wellness businesses. We found no dated changelog and have not used the product ourselves.

item.title: zastech Review (2026): Pay-Once Business Tools From $15
item.description: zastech: Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder are free forever with a small zastech footer.

item.title: SignThis Review (2026): Free Plan, $8/mo, Tested Nov 2026
item.description: SignThis has a free plan that sends 3 documents a month with no card and no end date. Built for senders who sign a few documents a month for free.

item.title: Forwardly Review (2026): $0 Plan, ACH Fees and Limits
item.description: Forwardly has no monthly platform fee. The price page is clear about fees, but the headline savings depend on both sides being on the Forwardly Network.

item.title: ChristianSteven Review (2026): Power BI and Tableau Scheduling
item.description: ChristianSteven sells four report-automation products. Only the smallest PBRS tier has a public price.

item.title: Pagely Review (2026): Managed WordPress Hosting From $99 a Month
item.description: Pagely: StartPress costs $99 a month for 5 WordPress sites, 30 GB SSD storage, 50 GB bandwidth and 150 GB of PressCDN.

item.title: BulkCertPDF Review (Tested): Excel to Certificates, $19 Pass
item.description: BulkCertPDF has a Free plan, a one-off Batch Pass and a Pro subscription. We did not check how the hosted verification pages handle personal data.

item.title: SurvIQ Review (Tested): Survey Builder With Analysis and AI
item.description: SurvIQ has a Free plan with 50 responses a month, 1 user and up to 3 active surveys. The free plan allows only 50 responses a month and 3 active surveys.

item.title: Shortcut Chat Review (2026): Multi-Model AI Chat From $20/mo
item.description: Shortcut Chat: Pro is $20 a month or $216 a year, Pro+ is $40 a month or $432 a year. The usage allowance is the unknown.

item.title: Parallels Desktop Review (2026): Windows on Mac, From €99.99/yr
item.description: Parallels Desktop runs Windows, Linux or macOS in a virtual machine on a Mac. Your Windows licence is a separate cost and is not included in any edition.

item.title: Finmo Review (2026): $0 Business Account, 0.07% Intro FX
item.description: Finmo: $0 to open, $0 a month, no minimum balance and unlimited user seats at no charge. The low FX rate is an introductory offer with strings.

item.title: Upwork Review (2026): Freelance Hiring Fees Explained
item.description: Upwork is a marketplace where clients hire freelancers. The Client Marketplace Fee is not refundable even if the payment is refunded.

item.title: AML Watcher Review (2026): AML Screening, Setup From $250
item.description: AML Watcher sells anti-money-laundering screening in three plans. The recurring price is only visible after you set the search volume in the calculator.

item.title: WPForms Review (2026): WordPress Forms From $49.50/Year
item.description: WPForms: $49.50 a year for one site (Basic), $99.50 for three (Plus), $199.50 for five (Pro) and $299.50 for unlimited sites (Elite).

item.title: UPDF Review (2026): PDF Editor, Lifetime or Yearly With AI
item.description: UPDF: US$0 for the AI part today, then it renews at US$69 a year unless you cancel. The free version puts a trial watermark on edited files.

item.title: Petty Cash Manager Review (2026): From $3.50/mo Billed Yearly
item.description: Petty Cash Manager: 3 months is $16.99 ($5.66 a month) on 3 devices. Without the Cloud sync add-on, your records live in the browser on each device.

item.title: Acronis True Image Review (2026): €49.99/yr, Cloud on Advanced
item.description: Acronis: For 1 computer it is €124.99 a year with 1 TB of cloud storage and goes up to €559.99 a year with 10 TB. Essentials has no cloud storage at all.

item.title: Slasify Review (2026): EOR From $250, Contractors From $50
item.description: Slasify: Three services, each with a starting price and a custom quote. Only starting prices are public.

item.title: Sucuri Review (2026): Website Firewall and Cleanup, From $229/yr
item.description: Sucuri sells per website. Pricing is per site, so costs climb quickly for agencies, and plans for 10 or more sites have no published price.

item.title: NexGen Virtual Office Review (2026): Hybrid Teams, $15-$25 a User
item.description: NexGen Virtual Office: Enterprise customers, which the page describes as 1,000 or more seats, have to book a demo. We found no current free trial.

item.title: pCloud Review (2026): Lifetime Cloud Storage From €219 Once
item.description: pCloud: Premium 500 GB is €219 (struck through from €279). Client-side encryption is not included in personal plans; it is a separate €150 purchase.

item.title: Recruit CRM Review (2026): Agency ATS and CRM, From €79 a User
item.description: Recruit CRM: Pro is €79 per user a month billed annually or €95 monthly, with 100 credits per user a month. The headline seat price is not the whole bill.

item.title: Netart Review (2026): CloudHosting, $18.75 Promo First Term
item.description: Netart sells a broad range of cloud services. The headline offers are first-period promotions; after them you pay the standard $18.75, $37.50 or $75 a month.

item.title: PDF Agile Review (2026): One-Time Plans, Lifetime at $119
item.description: PDF Agile: The free version limits conversion to 2 pages and 5 tasks. The Semi-Annual and Annual plans are one-time payments tied to an upgrade period.

item.title: Liltio Review (2026): Local Mac Dictation, $49 Once
item.description: Liltio: $49 standard price, with no recurring subscription. Speech recognition is local, but if you switch on a configured remote AI for text transforms.

item.title: WordPerfect Office Review (2026): One-Time Licence, Windows Only
item.description: WordPerfect Office: On 22 October 2026 the full version download was $99.99 for Home & Student, $249.99 for Standard and $399.99 for Professional.
